content: We have trained the model using an AdamW optimiser BIBREF17 with the learning rate set to 3e-5, as recommended by devlin2018bert, and with a gradient clipping of 1.0. We also applied a learning-rate scheduler that warms up the learning rate from zero to its maximum value as the training progresses, which is also a common practice. For each experiment set proposed below, the training was run with an early-stopping patience of 15 epochs. Then, the model that performed best against the development set was used to produce the reported results.
